Body.Content:
Now generally available, Azure diagnostics logs for Azure Cosmos DB will enable users to see logs for all requests made to their respective database account at the individual request level. The diagnostics logs help track how and when your databases are accessed. This feature will also provide a convenient method for configuring the destination of the logs for the customer. Users will be able to choose the destination to either Storage Account, Event Hub or Operation Management Suite Log Analytics.

Learn More about Operation Management Suite. 

Learn More about Azure Diagnostics logs for Azure Cosmos DB.
